Strawberry Tart
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 10:07pm

Ingredients




1 Graham Cracker pie shell,
2 cups Low-fat milk,(2%%)
ounce (1 pkg) sugar-free vanilla instant pudding mix
1 teaspoon Orange rind, grated freshly
2 cups Strawberries, cleaned &
Hauled( other berries maybe substituted

Preparation

1 Use an 8- or 9-inch tart pan with removeable bottom. 2 Firmly pat gramham cracker pie shell into tart pan. 3 Set aside. Blend milk with instant pudding mix in deep bowl using a whisk or an electric mixer. Continue mixing at low speed for 1 minute or until pudding is dissolved. Add grated orange rind. Let stand for 5 minutes and pour into pie shell. Let stand for 15 minutes or until set. Arrange strawberries or other berries decoratively over pudding shortly before This recipe is suitable for occasional use. Use unsalted margarine in pie shell.
